issues.description: The provided template Main.java (commented example usage) calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and the solution implement and describe the method as feedAllAnimals(). This name mismatch in the starter Main can confuse students who uncomment and try the example, as farm.feed() does not exist in the specified API.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the commented example in template Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() to match the specification and solution. Alternatively, add a convenience method feed() in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() so both names work.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution specify a Farm method named 'feedAllAnimals()', but the template Main.java calls 'farm.feed()'. issues.suggestedFix: Change the call in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java from 'farm.feed();' to 'farm.feedAllAnimals();' so the template example matches the method name required in the problem statement and implemented in the solution.
